expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Copies another TSubclassOf<T> value. Assigns a UClass after validating that it derives from T. Implicitly converts the typed class value to UClass. Implicitly exposes the selected UClass as its UObject base. Copies another TObjectPtr<T>. Assigns a compatible UObject reference. Implicitly converts the wrapper to its UObject reference. Copies another TWeakObjectPtr<T>. Assigns a compatible UObject without taking ownership. Implicitly resolves the weak pointer to a live UObject, or null.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Default, explicit, copy, and assignment inputs documented by the listed signatures; include independence or identity checks after copying.
testScope: Subclass = Other; | Subclass = Class; | UClass Class = Subclass; | UObject Object = Subclass; | ObjectPtr = Other; | ObjectPtr = Object; | T Object = ObjectPtr; | WeakPtr = Other; | WeakPtr = Object; | T Object = WeakPtr;
